labels.cancelled_note: The run was cancelled by the user; only the items processed before cancellation are reported.
labels.method_text: Each file was opened read-only and hashed in a single pass with the selected algorithms. Chat exports were read into one model (participants, conversations, messages, attachments), local times converted to UTC with the examiner's time zone, and written as RSMF 2.0 files, one per conversation per day, then checked against the RSMF 2.0 schema and read back. Every action was written to a hash-chained audit log.
labels.next_ok: No action needed for this file.
labels.next_attention: Review the findings below with your examiner before relying on this file.
labels.next_problem: Do not rely on this file until the examiner has explained the problem.
labels.summary_ok: The file was hashed and checked. The checks applied found no issues.
labels.summary_attention: The file was hashed and checked. Some points need attention.
labels.summary_problem: The file could not be fully examined or shows a serious problem.
labels.fingerprint_text: This fingerprint identifies the exact content of the file. Any change, even of one character, would produce a different value.

labels.conv_summary_ok: This export was converted into %{files} RSMF file(s) holding %{events} event(s) from %{conversations} conversation(s); every file passed the RSMF 2.0 schema, the stricter checks and the read-back test.
labels.conv_summary_invalid: This export was converted into %{files} RSMF file(s) holding %{events} event(s) from %{conversations} conversation(s); %{invalid} file(s) FAILED validation and must not be loaded until fixed.
labels.conv_failed: This export could not be converted:

EMPTY_FILE.title: Empty file
EMPTY_FILE.shows: The file contains no data (0 bytes).
EMPTY_FILE.does_not_prove: It does not show whether the file was emptied deliberately or created empty.

EXTENSION_MISMATCH.title: Extension does not match content
EXTENSION_MISMATCH.shows: The name ends in .%{extension} but the content starts with the signature of a %{detected} file.
EXTENSION_MISMATCH.does_not_prove: Renaming is common and often innocent; it does not by itself prove an attempt to hide content.

EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.title: Executable content under another name
EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.shows: The content is a %{detected} program although the name ends in .%{extension}.
EXECUTABLE_CONTENT.does_not_prove: It does not show that the program is malicious; analyse it in an isolated environment.

DUPLICATE.title: Duplicate content
DUPLICATE.does_not_prove: Identical hashes show identical content, not who copied the file or when.

UNREADABLE.title: File could not be read
UNREADABLE.does_not_prove: It does not show that the file is damaged; permissions or locks can cause this.

EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.title: Differs from the evidence registered in the case
EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.shows: The %{algorithm} of this file is %{actual}, but evidence %{evidence_id} was registered at intake with %{expected}: the file examined is not bit-identical to the registered item.
EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH_WITH_CASE.does_not_prove: Who changed the file, when, or whether the change was deliberate; the analysis still ran so the examiner can decide.

EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.title: Not registered in the case
EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.shows: No item of case %{case_id} was registered with this path or this content, so its continuity from intake cannot be shown.
EVIDENCE_NOT_IN_CASE_REGISTRY.does_not_prove: That the file is altered or irrelevant; it may simply not have gone through intake.

REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.title: Registered path now holds different content
REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.shows: This path was registered earlier as %{previous_id} with other content; the current content gets a new evidence ID.
REGISTRY_PATH_CONTENT_CHANGED.does_not_prove: Which version is the original or why the content changed.

DATE_ORDER_INFERRED.title: Date order inferred from the export
DATE_ORDER_INFERRED.shows: Numeric dates were read as %{order}: line %{line} ("%{example}") can only be read that way.
DATE_ORDER_INFERRED.does_not_prove: It does not show that every line was written with the same phone settings; an export that mixes day-first and month-first dates stops with an error instead of being converted.

DATE_ORDER_CHOSEN.title: Date order chosen by the examiner
DATE_ORDER_CHOSEN.shows: The dates in this export fit more than one order; the examiner chose %{order} (--date-order).
DATE_ORDER_CHOSEN.does_not_prove: The choice is the examiner's; the export itself does not say which order the phone used.

TIMEZONE_APPLIED.title: Local times converted with the examiner's time zone
TIMEZONE_APPLIED.shows: The export's times carry no UTC offset; they were read as %{timezone} and stored in UTC. The original text of each time is kept in the event's custom field source_time.
TIMEZONE_APPLIED.does_not_prove: It does not show that the phone was set to %{timezone}; a wrong zone shifts every time by the same amount.

DST_AMBIGUOUS_OR_MISSING_TIME.title: Times at a daylight-saving change
DST_AMBIGUOUS_OR_MISSING_TIME.shows: %{count} time(s) fall in a clock change in %{timezone} (repeated hour: earlier instant used; skipped hour: moved forward): %{examples}.
DST_AMBIGUOUS_OR_MISSING_TIME.does_not_prove: It does not show which of the two instants was meant for a repeated hour.

NON_MONOTONIC_TIMESTAMPS.title: Messages out of time order
NON_MONOTONIC_TIMESTAMPS.shows: %{count} message(s) have an earlier time than the message before them in the export (first at %{first}).
NON_MONOTONIC_TIMESTAMPS.does_not_prove: Clock changes, network delays and edits all cause this; it does not show that messages were inserted.

UNPARSED_LINES.title: Lines that could not be read
UNPARSED_LINES.shows: %{count} line(s) or record(s) matched no known format and are not in the RSMF output; first: %{examples}.
UNPARSED_LINES.does_not_prove: It does not show that content is missing from the conversation; these may be headers or damaged lines. Review them in the export.

MEDIA_OMITTED_IN_EXPORT.title: Media not included in the export
MEDIA_OMITTED_IN_EXPORT.shows: %{count} message(s) say the media was omitted when the chat was exported ("without media").
MEDIA_OMITTED_IN_EXPORT.does_not_prove: It does not show what the media contained, or that it was deleted from the phone.

ATTACHMENT_REFERENCED_NOT_FOUND.title: Referenced file not found
ATTACHMENT_REFERENCED_NOT_FOUND.shows: %{count} attachment(s) are named in the export but the file is not in it: %{examples}.
ATTACHMENT_REFERENCED_NOT_FOUND.does_not_prove: It does not show that the file was removed on purpose; exports can be incomplete.

TELEGRAM_FILE_NOT_INCLUDED.title: Telegram files left out of the export
TELEGRAM_FILE_NOT_INCLUDED.shows: %{count} file(s) were not exported (the export settings excluded them, or they were too large or unavailable).
TELEGRAM_FILE_NOT_INCLUDED.does_not_prove: It does not show what the files contained.

REACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_RELATIVITY.title: Reactions Relativity will show as text
REACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_RELATIVITY.shows: These reactions have no Relativity shortcode and are stored as text: %{values}.
REACTION_NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_RELATIVITY.does_not_prove: It does not change the reaction; only how the viewer displays it.

EDIT_HISTORY_NOT_IN_EXPORT.title: Edited messages without their earlier text
EDIT_HISTORY_NOT_IN_EXPORT.shows: %{count} message(s) are marked as edited, but the export contains only the last version.
EDIT_HISTORY_NOT_IN_EXPORT.does_not_prove: It does not show what the earlier text said.

DELETED_MESSAGES_NOT_IN_EXPORT.title: Deleted messages are not exported
DELETED_MESSAGES_NOT_IN_EXPORT.shows: %{source} exports leave out messages deleted before the export; the RSMF can only contain what the export contains.
DELETED_MESSAGES_NOT_IN_EXPORT.does_not_prove: It does not show whether any messages were deleted.

POSSIBLE_EXPORT_LIMIT.title: Export may be truncated
POSSIBLE_EXPORT_LIMIT.shows: The export holds %{count} messages, close to the limit WhatsApp is reported to apply to chat exports (about 40,000 without media, 10,000 with media; not confirmed by WhatsApp).
POSSIBLE_EXPORT_LIMIT.does_not_prove: It does not show that messages are missing; compare with a forensic extraction of the phone.

PARTICIPANT_IDENTIFIED_BY_NUMBER_ONLY.title: Participants known only by phone number
PARTICIPANT_IDENTIFIED_BY_NUMBER_ONLY.shows: %{count} participant(s) appear only as a number (not in the exporting phone's contacts): %{examples}.
PARTICIPANT_IDENTIFIED_BY_NUMBER_ONLY.does_not_prove: A number does not identify a person; establish who used it from other evidence.

DAY_SPLIT_OVER_10000_EVENTS.title: Busy day split into several files
DAY_SPLIT_OVER_10000_EVENTS.shows: %{conversation} has more than 10,000 events on %{day}; that day was written as %{parts} files (Relativity's limit per file).
DAY_SPLIT_OVER_10000_EVENTS.does_not_prove: It does not change any message; all parts share the same event collection id.

DUPLICATE_MESSAGES.title: Repeated messages
DUPLICATE_MESSAGES.shows: %{count} message(s) repeat an earlier one exactly (same sender, time and text).
DUPLICATE_MESSAGES.does_not_prove: Re-sends and export glitches cause this; it does not show manipulation. All copies are kept.

CSV_MAPPING_DRAFT_PROFILE.title: Column mapping not yet validated
CSV_MAPPING_DRAFT_PROFILE.shows: The CSV was read with the %{profile} column profile, which has not been checked against real exports of that tool.
CSV_MAPPING_DRAFT_PROFILE.does_not_prove: It does not show that the mapping is wrong; check a few messages against the source tool before relying on the RSMF.

RSMF_SCHEMA_INVALID.title: RSMF file failed validation
RSMF_SCHEMA_INVALID.shows: %{file} does not pass the RSMF 2.0 schema or rv-rsmf's stricter checks: %{errors}.
RSMF_SCHEMA_INVALID.does_not_prove: It does not show that the export is wrong; it shows this output must not be loaded into Relativity until fixed.

RSMF_ROUNDTRIP_MISMATCH.title: RSMF file does not read back as written
RSMF_ROUNDTRIP_MISMATCH.shows: Reading %{file} back gave different content from what was written: %{problems}.
RSMF_ROUNDTRIP_MISMATCH.does_not_prove: It does not show where the difference comes from (disk, antivirus, software fault); the file must be regenerated.

PARSER_FAILED.title: Export could not be converted
PARSER_FAILED.shows: The %{source} reader stopped on this export: %{error}. No RSMF was written for it; the rest of the run continued.
PARSER_FAILED.does_not_prove: It does not show that the export was tampered with; it may be damaged or in a format not yet supported.

PART_OF_EXPORT.title: File belongs to a chat export
PART_OF_EXPORT.shows: This file is part of the export %{export} (media or attachment) and was converted with it.
PART_OF_EXPORT.does_not_prove: It does not show which message refers to it; see the trace map.

NOT_A_CHAT_EXPORT.title: Not recognised as a chat export
NOT_A_CHAT_EXPORT.shows: The file is not a WhatsApp, Telegram, Teams .msg or CSV chat export and is not inside one; it was hashed but not converted.
NOT_A_CHAT_EXPORT.does_not_prove: It does not show that the file is irrelevant; force the source type with --source if it is a chat export.

limitations.SIGNATURE_TABLE_LIMITED: Type detection uses a limited table of common file signatures; unknown types are reported as unknown, not as suspicious.
limitations.TIMESTAMPS_FROM_FILESYSTEM: Modification times come from the file system of the examined copy and may differ from the original source.
limitations.CLEAN_RESULT_IS_NOT_AUTHENTICITY: A result without findings does not prove that a file is authentic or unaltered before acquisition.
limitations.TIMESTAMP_PROVES_EXISTENCE_ONLY: A trusted timestamp proves the audit log existed in this exact form at the stated time; it does not prove that the examined copy matches the original source.
limitations.CONVERSION_REPRESENTS_THE_EXPORT_NOT_THE: The RSMF files reproduce the export as delivered, not the phone or account: messages deleted before the export, unexported media and edit history are not in them.
limitations.EXPORT_CONTENT_NOT_AUTHENTICATED: rv-rsmf converts; it does not authenticate. A chat export is a text or JSON file that can be edited before it reaches the examiner; corroborate it with a forensic extraction or the other party's copy.
limitations.RELATIVITY_RENDERING_NOT_VERIFIED: Files are checked against the published RSMF 2.0 schema and read back; how a given Relativity version displays them was not tested by this run.
limitations.SHORTCODE_TABLE_VERSION: Reactions are mapped with a fixed table of Relativity emoji shortcodes (checked 2026-10-27); other reactions are kept as text.
